# Vimal Harihar S K

> Vimal Harihar S K (also written Vimalharihar S K, S. K. Vimal Harihar; GitHub: Goldmauler) is a Software Engineer and B.Tech Computer Science student (2023–2027) at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Coimbatore, India, working on AI/ML, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, edge AI/TinyML and distributed systems.

- Software & AI Intern at Innoboon (Apr–Jun 2026): RAG + Deep Agents for JIRA ↔ GCP incident correlation.
- Web Development Lead, Tensor AI Club, Amrita (2024–2026): led 20 developers; platform with 1,200+ users.
- Winner, Infineon PSoC 6 Sequence Quest Hackathon. Top 10 Grand Finalist (of 8,100+ teams): Caterpillar Tech Challenge 2026. Finalist: AWS AI for Bharat 2026, Smart India Hackathon 2025. 35+ hackathons.
- 4 research publications, including "AI's Influence on Gender Representation and Societal Norms in Emerging Technologies" (IEEE, 2025 International Conference on Gender and Technology) and "SecureAI-Cyber: An AI-Powered Cybersecurity Solution for Scalable Threat Management" (Springer, Scopus-indexed, ITAI 2025).
